verses.geez: ወኢትትገአዝ፡ ምስለ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ከመ፡ ኢትደቅ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴሆሙ።
verses.translation: Strive not with a mighty man, lest thou fall into his hands.

translations.lxx: Strive not with a mighty man, lest thou fall into his hands.
translations.ron: Nu te certa cu cel puternic, ca nu cumva să cazi în mâinile lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ διαμάχου μετὰ ἀνθρώπου δυνάστου, μήποτε ἐμπέσῃς εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወኢትትቀሐው፡ ምስለ፡ ዘይብዕለከ፡ ከመ፡ በብዕሉ፡ ኢይማእከ፡ እስመ፡ ብዙኃን፡ ተሀጕሉ፡ እንበይነ፡ ወርቅ፡ ቀይሕ፡ ወገመጾሙ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ለነገሥት።
verses.translation: Be not at variance with a rich man, lest he overweigh thee: for gold hath destroyed many, and perverted the hearts of kings.

translations.lxx: Be not at variance with a rich man, lest he overweigh thee: for gold hath destroyed many, and perverted the hearts of kings.
translations.ron: Nu te certa cu omul bogat, ca nu cumva să fie mai greu decât tine. Că pe mulţi i-a pierdut aurul şi inimile regilor le-a aplecat.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἔριζε μετὰ ἀνθρώπου πλουσίου, μήποτε ἀντιστήσῃ σου τὴν ὁλκήν· πολλους γὰρ ἀπώλεσε τὸ χρυσίον, καὶ καρδίας βασιλέων ἐξέκλινε.

verses.geez: ወኢትትላኰይ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲ፡ ነባቢ፡ ወእመ፡ አኮሰ፡ ወጣሕከ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ዲበ፡ እሳተ።
verses.translation: Strive not with a man that is full of tongue, and heap not wood upon his fire.

translations.lxx: Strive not with a man that is full of tongue, and heap not wood upon his fire.
translations.ron: Nu te sfădi cu omul care vorbeşte bine şi nu pune lemne peste focul lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ διαμάχου μετὰ ἀνθρώπου γλωσσώδους, καὶ μὴ ἐπιστοιβάσῃς ἐπὶ τὸ πῦρ αὐτοῦ ξύλα.

verses.geez: ኢትሥሐቅ፡ ወኢትሣለቅ፡ ምስለ፡ አብድ፡ ከመ፡ ኢታኅሥር፡ አዝማዲከ።
verses.translation: Jest not with a rude man, lest thy ancestors be disgraced.

translations.lxx: Jest not with a rude man, lest thy ancestors be disgraced.
translations.ron: Nu glumi cu omul rău crescut, ca să nu fie ocărâţi strămoşii tăi.
translations.grk: Μὴ πρόσπαιζε ἀπαιδεύτῳ, ἵνα μὴ ἀτιμάζωνται οἱ πρόγονοί σου.

verses.geez: ወኢትትሀበቦ፡ ለዘይትጋነይ፡ በእንተ፡ ጌጋዩ፡ ተዘከር፡ ከመ፡ ኵልነ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ንሕነ።
verses.translation: Reproach not a man that turneth from sin, but remember that we are all worthy of punishment.

translations.lxx: Reproach not a man that turneth from sin, but remember that we are all worthy of punishment.
translations.ron: Nu înfrunta pe omul care se leapădă de păcat, adu-ţi aminte că toţi suntem vinovaţi.
translations.grk: Μὴ ὀνείδιζε ἄνθρωπον ἀποστρέφοντα ἀπὸ ἁμαρτίας, μνήσθητι ὅτι πάντες ἐσμὲν ἐν ἐπιτιμίοις.

verses.geez: ወኢታስተአክዮ፡ ለሰብእ፡ በርሥዓቲሁ፡ እስመ፡ እምውስቴትነሂ፡ ቦ፡ ዘይረሥዕ።
verses.translation: Dishonour not a man in his old age: for even some of us wax old.

translations.lxx: Dishonour not a man in his old age: for even some of us wax old.
translations.ron: Să nu necinsteşti pe om la bătrâneţile lui, căci poate şi noi vom îmbătrâni.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἀτιμάσῃς ἄνθρωπον ἐν γήρει αὐτοῦ, καὶ γὰρ ἐξ ἡμῶν γηράσκουσι.

verses.geez: ኢትትፌሣሕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘሞተ፡ ተዘከር፡ ከመ፡ ኵልነ፡ ንመውት።
verses.translation: Rejoice not over thy greatest enemy being dead, but remember that we die all.

translations.lxx: Rejoice not over thy greatest enemy being dead, but remember that we die all.
translations.ron: Nu te bucura de moartea vrăjmaşului tău, adu-ţi aminte că toţi trebuie să murim.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐπίχαιρε ἐπὶ νεκρῷ, μνήσθητι ὅτι πάντες τελευτῶμεν.

verses.geez: ኢታስትት፡ ነገረ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ወተመሀር፡ አምሳሊሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ በኀቤሆሙ፡ ትረክባ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ወተፀመድ፡ መኳንንተ።
verses.translation: Despise not the discourse of the wise, but acquaint thyself with their proverbs: for of them thou shalt learn instruction, and how to serve great men with ease.

translations.lxx: Despise not the discourse of the wise, but acquaint thyself with their proverbs: for of them thou shalt learn instruction, and how to serve great men with ease.
translations.ron: Nu trece cu vederea vorbele înţelepţilor, ci la pildele lor opreşte-te, căci de la ei vei lua învăţătura şi îndemânarea de a sluji celor mai mari.
translations.grk: Μὴ παρίδῃς διήγημα σοφῶν, καὶ ἐν ταῖς παροιμίαις αὐτῶν ἀναστρέφου, ὅτι παρʼ αὐτῶν μαθήσῃ παιδείαν, καὶ λειτουργῆσαι μεγιστᾶσι.

verses.geez: ወዕቀብ፡ ተግሣጾሙ፡ ለአእሩግ፡ እስመ፡ እሙንቱሂ፡ በኀበ፡ አበዊሆሙ፡ ተምህሩ፡ ወአንተሂ፡ በኀቤሆሙ፡ ትመሀር፡ ወትረክብ፡ ዘትነብብ፡ በጊዜ፡ ትካዝከ፡ ወተአምር፡ ዘታወሥእ።
verses.translation: Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers, and of them thou shalt learn understanding, and to give answer as need requireth.

translations.lxx: Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers, and of them thou shalt learn understanding, and to give answer as need requireth.
translations.ron: Nu dispreţui vorba celor bătrâni, că şi ei au învăţat de la părinţii lor. Că de la ei vei învăţa înţelepciunea şi îndemânarea de a da răspuns bun la nevoie.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἀστόχει διηγήματος γερόντων, καὶ γὰρ αὐτοὶ ἔμαθον παρὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν· ὅτι παρʼ αὐτῶν μαθήσῃ σύνεσιν, καὶ ἐν καιρῷ χρείας δοῦναι ἀπόκρισιν.

verses.geez: ኢትሱጥ፡ እሳቶሙ፡ ለኃጥኣን፡ ከመ፡ ኢተዐይ፡ በነዶሙ።
verses.translation: Kindle not the coals of a sinner, lest thou be burnt with the flame of his fire.

translations.lxx: Kindle not the coals of a sinner, lest thou be burnt with the flame of his fire.
translations.ron: Nu aţâţa cărbunii păcătosului, ca să nu te ardă flacăra focului lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἔκκαιε ἄνθρακας ἁμαρτωλοῦ, μὴ ἐμπυρισθῇς ἐν πυρὶ φλογὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ኢትትዋሣእ፡ በኀበ፡ ጸላኢ፡ ጸዓሊ፡ ከመ፡ ኢያስሕትከ፡ በቃለ፡ አፉሁ።
verses.translation: Rise not up [in anger] at the presence of an injurious person, lest he lie in wait to entrap thee in thy words.

translations.lxx: Rise not up [in anger] at the presence of an injurious person, lest he lie in wait to entrap thee in thy words.
translations.ron: Nu o duce până la capăt cu omul iute la mânie, ca să nu fie o cursă întinsă înaintea buzelor tale.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐξαναστῇς ἀπὸ προσώπου ὑβριστοῦ, ἵνα μὴ ἐγκαθίσῃ ὡς ἔνεδρον τῷ στόματί σου.

verses.geez: ወኢትለቅሖ፡ ለዘይብዕለከ፡ ወለእመሰ፡ ለቃሕካሁ፡ ረሲ፡ ከመ፡ ዘሀጐልከ።
verses.translation: Lend not unto him that is mightier than thyself; for if thou lendest him, count it but lost.

translations.lxx: Lend not unto him that is mightier than thyself; for if thou lendest him, count it but lost.
translations.ron: Nu da împrumut omului celui mai tare decât tine; şi de-l vei împrumuta, socoteşte împrumutul ca pierdut.
translations.grk: Μὴ δανείσῃς ἀνθρώπῳ ἰσχυροτέρῳ σου, καὶ ἐὰν δανείσῃς, ὡς ἀπολωλεκὼς γίνου·

verses.geez: ኢትትሐበዮ፡ ለዘይጸንዐከ፡ ወለእመሰ፡ ተሐበይካሁ፡ ኀሊ፡ እንከ፡ ዘከመ፡ ትፈዲ፡ ለሊከ።
verses.translation: Be not surety above thy power: for if thou be surety, take care to pay it.

translations.lxx: Be not surety above thy power: for if thou be surety, take care to pay it.
translations.ron: Nu chezăşui peste puterea ta; iar dacă ai dat chezăşie, fii cu grijă că va trebui să plăteşti.
translations.grk: Μὴ ἐγγυήσῃ ὑπὲρ δυναμίν σου, καὶ ἐὰν ἐγγυήσῃ, ὡς ἀποτίσων φρόντιζε.

verses.geez: ኢትሳነን፡ ምስለ፡ መኰንን፡ እስመ፡ በከመ፡ ክብሩ፡ ያገብኡ፡ ሎቱ፡ ፍትሐ።
verses.translation: Go not to law with a judge; for they will judge for him according to his honour.

translations.lxx: Go not to law with a judge; for they will judge for him according to his honour.
translations.ron: Nu te judeca cu un judecător, căci hotărârea va fi în folosul lui.
translations.grk: Μὴ δικάζου μετὰ κριτοῦ, κατὰ γὰρ τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ κρινοῦσιν αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ምስለ፡ መስተኀብል፡ ኢትኅበር፡ መንገደ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትመዐዕ፡ ላዕሌከ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱሰ፡ ዘፈተወ፡ ልቡ፡ ይገብር፡ ወትመውት፡ አንተ፡ በእበደ፡ ዚኣሁ።
verses.translation: Travel not by the way with a bold fellow, lest he become grievous unto thee: for he will do according to his own will, and thou shalt perish with him through his folly.

translations.lxx: Travel not by the way with a bold fellow, lest he become grievous unto thee: for he will do according to his own will, and thou shalt perish with him through his folly.
translations.ron: Nu porni la drum cu cel cutezător ca să nu-ţi cadă povară, căci el nu face decât după capul său, şi nebunia lui te va pierde.
translations.grk: Μετὰ τολμηροῦ μὴ πορεύου ἐν ὁδῷ, ἵνα μὴ βαρύνηται κατὰ σοῦ· αὐτὸς γὰρ κατὰ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιήσει, καὶ τῇ ἀφροσύνῃ αὐτοῦ συναπολῇ.

verses.geez: ወኢትትገአዝ፡ ምስለ፡ መዐትም፡ ወኢትፃእ፡ ሐቅለ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ እስመ፡ ከመ፡ ወኢ፡ ምንት፡ ክዒወ፡ ደም፡ በኀበ፡ ዐይኑ፡ ወበኀበ፡ አልቦ፡ ረድኤት፡ ይወስደከ።
verses.translation: Strive not with an angry man, and go not with him into a solitary place: for blood is as nothing in his sight; and where there is no help, he will overthrow thee.

translations.lxx: Strive not with an angry man, and go not with him into a solitary place: for blood is as nothing in his sight; and where there is no help, he will overthrow thee.
translations.ron: Nu te certa cu omul mânios şi nu străbate pustiul cu el, căci a vărsa sânge este pentru el nimica toată şi unde nu vei avea ajutor, te va doborî.
translations.grk: Μετὰ θυμώδους μὴ ποιήσῃς μάχην, καὶ μὴ διαπορεύου μετʼ αὐτοῦ τὴν ἔρημον, ὅτι ὡς οὐδὲν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ αἷμα, καὶ ὅπου οὐκ ἔστι βοήθεια, καταβαλεῖ σε.

verses.geez: ወኢትትማከር፡ ምስለ፡ አብድ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይክል፡ ዐቂበ፡ ነገር፡ ዘሰምዐ።
verses.translation: Consult not with a fool; for he cannot keep counsel.

translations.lxx: Consult not with a fool; for he cannot keep counsel.
translations.ron: Nu ţine sfat cu un nebun, căci el nu va putea păstra taina ta.
translations.grk: Μετὰ μωροῦ μὴ συμβουλεύου, οὐ γὰρ δυνήσεται λόγον στέξαι.

verses.geez: ኢትንግር፡ ቅድመ፡ ነኪር፡ ትካዘከ፡ እስመ፡ ኢተአምር፡ እፎ፡ ይበጽሐከ።
verses.translation: Do no secret thing before a stranger: for thou knowest not what he will bring forth.

translations.lxx: Do no secret thing before a stranger: for thou knowest not what he will bring forth.
translations.ron: Înaintea celui străin nu face nimic care trebuie să rămână tăinuit; tu nu ştii ce poate născoci el.
translations.grk: Ἐνώπιον ἀλλοτρίου μὴ ποιήσῃς κρυπτὸν, οὐ γὰρ γινώσκεις τί τέξεται.

verses.geez: ኢትክሥት፡ ለኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ልብከ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩንከ፡ ህጉለ፡ ዕሴትከ።
verses.translation: Open not thine heart to every man, lest he requite thee with a shrewd turn.

translations.lxx: Open not thine heart to every man, lest he requite thee with a shrewd turn.
translations.ron: Nu deschide inima ta oricui şi nu aştepta să dobândeşti bunăvoinţa lui.
translations.grk: Παντὶ ἀνθρώπῳ μὴ ἔκφαινε σὴν καρδίαν, καὶ μὴ ἀναφερέτω σοι χάριν.
